AC-001.description: When the beach page loads, the Today's Tides card shall display an interactive tide curve chart that fills the available card width with proportional height

AC-002.description: While viewing the Today's Tides card, the system shall display all high and low tide times and heights in a legible format (minimum 14px font) with clear color coding

AC-003.description: When the user hovers or taps on the tide curve, the system shall show a tooltip with interpolated tide height and time

AC-004.description: The system shall display a Now marker on the tide curve indicating current time position

AC-005.description: When the Tide Forecast section loads, the system shall display day cards at a minimum width of 160px with adequate spacing

AC-006.description: Each day card shall display a mini tide curve that is at least 50px tall and 140px wide with visible high/low markers

AC-007.description: When the forecast has more days than fit on screen, the system shall support horizontal scrolling with snap behavior

AC-008.description: The system shall render all pages using light theme only, with no dark mode toggle visible in the UI

AC-009.description: When viewing the site, background colors shall use warm sandy tones and cards shall use white backgrounds with subtle ocean-tinted shadows

AC-010.description: The system shall use ocean, shore, sky, and sand color palettes with addition of warm sandy beige tones for backgrounds

AC-011.description: While the dark mode toggle is removed from UI, ThemeProvider and dark: CSS classes shall be retained in code for future re-enablement

AC-012.description: Each beach shall display a hero image that is an actual photograph of that specific Vancouver beach

AC-013.description: The system shall display photo credit attribution below or overlaid on the hero image

AC-014.description: If a beach has no verified photo available, the system shall display a gradient fallback rather than an incorrect stock photo

AC-015.description: Each beach page shall display an About This Beach section with multi-paragraph description covering unique features, best activities, and practical tips

AC-016.description: The description section shall include structured highlights (best for, vibe, crowd level)

AC-017.description: When the beach page loads, the Should you go today section shall display a Beach Score (0-100) synthesizing temperature, weather, UV, wind, and tide conditions

AC-018.description: The Beach Score shall be accompanied by a short natural-language recommendation

AC-019.description: When viewing Plan Your Visit, amenities shall be displayed with Lucide icons in a visually consistent grid layout

AC-020.description: The system shall visually distinguish available amenities (solid colored icons) from unavailable ones (grayed out with strikethrough)

AC-021.description: Each beach page shall display a Safety section with relevant warnings when applicable

AC-022.description: If the water quality status is advisory or closed, then the system shall display a prominent warning banner at the top of the page

ADR-001.title: De-prioritize dark mode (light-only default, keep code)
ADR-001.rationale: Lowest risk approach - achieves visual goal without removing dark: classes from 36 files, preserves re-enablement path

ADR-002.title: Hybrid photo sourcing (Unsplash curation first, self-hosted later)
ADR-002.rationale: Zero architecture changes needed, delivers correct photos immediately with existing BeachImage type

ADR-003.title: Two coordinated tide components (TideCanvas + TideForecast redesign)
ADR-003.rationale: Maps to user mental models (today vs. forecast), allows independent testing and iteration
